# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**My top pick: Soundcore Space One (about $100, or about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products named it the best overall under $100, citing adaptive ANC, balanced sound, rotating ear cups and a 55-hour battery (40 hours with ANC on). [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- Dealectric reports that code AFSC20 took $19.99 off at Soundcore's US store on 2026-10-22, bringing the price to about $80. It says the code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't work on items already on sale, and that checkout has the final word.
- Downsides: it's heavier than some rivals and has no sweat resistance, and LDAC doesn't work with two devices connected.
- [Buy at Soundcore (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)

**Other good options**

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Strongest ANC | Anker Soundcore Space Q45 | ~$99 | RTINGS' best budget ANC headphones, with great engine-rumble reduction and 28 hours of battery in its tests. Some owners report headband cracks. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) |
| Cheapest good ANC | Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024) | Not listed | Nearly matches the Q45's isolation, with 49 hours of battery. The build feels plasticky. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) |
| Lightweight comfort | Sony WH-CH720N | ~$99 | Weighs 192 g, but supports only SBC and AAC (no LDAC). [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/) |
| Tight budget | Edifier Atom Max | ~$45 | Hybrid ANC and a 45-hour battery, but no 3.5mm jack. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/) |
| Long battery and comfort | Edifier W820NB Plus | ~$79 | 49 hours of battery, LDAC and plush earcups, but no case. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/) |
| Phone calls | JBL Tune 760NC | ~$79 (varies) | Best mic among RTINGS' under-$100 picks, but weaker ANC and a tight fit. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100) |
| Sturdier build | CMF Headphone Pro | Not listed | Stainless-steel hinges and splash resistance, though RTINGS' text on its noise isolation was cut off. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) |

**Notes**
- Prices change often, so check the retailer before buying.
- I only have a direct buy link for the Space One. The other links are review pages where you can find current prices.
- The CartIQ page is inconsistent: it labels the Sony its "top pick" but its text calls the Q45 the best.
- If you want more noise blocking than anything here, TechRadar's best-under-$100 pick is the 1More SonoFlow Pro. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

I can narrow this down if you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, and whether you'll use them mostly for travel, the office, or calls.
